description: This file defines a Java interface 'RefreshTokenRepository' that extends JpaRepository, providing methods to access and manipulate refresh token data in a database within a Spring Boot application. It includes custom query methods for finding tokens by hash, user ID with revocation status, and deleting expired tokens.

classes.name: RefreshTokenRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface providing data access methods for 'RefreshToken' entities.

methods.name: findByTokenHash
methods.description: Retrieves an optional RefreshToken entity matching the given token hash.

methods.name: findByUserIdAndRevokedFalse
methods.description: Finds a list of refresh tokens for a specific user ID that have not been revoked.

methods.name: deleteByExpiresAtBefore
methods.description: Deletes refresh tokens that have expired before the specified timestamp.
